    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AllSetFoodStrategy
    Building effect that rewards the player with food whenever a new complete character set is formed.
    Artifact
    Artifact symbols found on CharacterType.INVENTOR character cards.
    ArtistEventStrategy
    Artist event effect, applied to every player when the event resolves.
    Board
    Acts as the central facade for the game board state.
    BoardCenterController
    Controller for the central area of the game board.
    BoardDTO
    The root Data Transfer Object (DTO) for the game's initial configuration.
    BoardSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of the board state.
    BuilderStrategy
    Immediate effect of the Builder character.
    BuildingCard
    Represents a Building card within the game.
    BuildingCardPickedDelta
    GameDelta sent when a player picks a building card from the shared "showed" rows.
    Card
    The abstract base class representing a generic playable card in the game.
    CardDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to deserialize card blueprints from the JSON configuration file.
    CardStrategy
    The abstract base of the Strategy pattern used to model every card effect in the game.
    CharacterCard
    Represents a specific character card within the game.
    CharacterCardPickedDelta
    GameDelta sent when a player picks a character card from the shared "showed" tribe rows.
    CharacterType
    Categories of character cards that players can acquire for their tribe.
    ClientGameState
    Client-side replica of the game state, built from a GameSnapshot and updated incrementally via GameDelta objects received from the server.
    ClientMain
    Entry point for the Mesos client application.
    ClientModel
    Client-side model that holds the local replica of the game state (ClientGameState) and notifies registered observers whenever the state changes.
    ClientPlayerState
    Client-side replica of a single player's state, built from a PlayerSnapshot and updated incrementally via GameDelta objects.
    Deck<T>
    Represents a generic deck of cards in the game.
    DoubleBuilderPPStrategy
    Building effect that doubles the prestige points the player earns from his builders (at the end of the game).
    DoubleShamanPPStrategy
    Building effect that doubles the prestige points the player gains from shaman events.
    EndGameDelta
    GameDelta broadcast when the game ends.
    EndGamePhase
    Represents the terminal phase of the game.
    EndGamePhaseSnapshot
    PhaseSnapshot for the end-of-game phase.
    EndTurnDelta
    GameDelta broadcast at the end of a turn.
    EndTurnPhase
    A transient resolution phase triggered at the end of every round.
    EndTurnPhaseSnapshot
    PhaseSnapshot for the end-of-turn phase.
    Era
    Represents the chronological periods (eras) of the game.
    EventCard
    Represents an Event card within the game.
    EventInfo
    Lightweight, serializable descriptor of a game event triggered during a turn.
    EventType
    Types of event cards that can appear during a round.
    ExtraFoodOnFoodStrategy
    Building effect that grants one extra food whenever the player gains food from returning to the offer turn card.
    ExtraPickStrategy
    Building effect that grants the current player the right to an additional pick.
    Game
    Aggregate root representing a single game session and all of its mutable state.
    GameBoardController
    Main controller for the game board scene.
    GameController
    Thin controller layer that mediates between the network layer (via Socket or RMI) and the game model.
    GameDelta
    Base type for all incremental game state updates ("deltas") sent from the server to the clients.
    GameManager
    Central coordinator for all active game sessions running on the Mesos server.
    GamePhase
    Defines the contract for the State pattern managing the game's lifecycle.
    GameRepository
    Abstraction over the persistent storage of game snapshots.
    GameResult
    Immutable value object representing a single player's outcome in a completed game.
    GameSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of the whole game state at a given instant.
    GUIViewFxml
    Main entry point for launching the JavaFX FXML-based graphical user interface.
    HuntEventStrategy
    Hunt event effect, applied to every player when the event resolves.
    ImageCache
    Caches and provides access to all image assets used by the GUI.
    IntergalacticRankingController
    Controller for the intergalactic ranking (historical leaderboard) scene.
    InvalidActionException
    Thrown when a player attempts an action that violates the game rules or the current game state (e.g. placing a totem on an occupied slot, taking a card out of turn, or joining with a nickname already in use).
    InventorsPairStrategy
    Building effect that rewards the player with food whenever a new inventor pair is formed.
    InventorStrategy
    Immediate effect of the Inventor character.
    JoinGameController
    Controller for the "Join Game" screen where the player enters their nickname, selects the number of players, and starts a new game.
    JoinResult
    An immutable data transfer object representing the server's response when a player successfully joins a game or lobby.
    JsonGameRepository
    File-system implementation of GameRepository that persists each game as a JSON file.
    LauncherClient
    Thin launcher wrapper around ClientMain, used as the JAR's main class.
    LeaderboardController
    Controller for the end-of-game leaderboard scene.
    LeaderboardDelta
    GameDelta that delivers the final leaderboard to the clients.
    LeaderboardRepository
    Data-access abstraction for persisting and querying game results.
    LoadingLobbyController
    Controller for the loading lobby scene shown while waiting for other players to join.
    MesosMenuController
    Controller for the main menu scene.
    MesosServer
    Central, transport-agnostic hub for broadcasting notifications to connected clients.
    ModelInterface
    Contract exposed by the model to the network layer (Socket / RMI handlers).
    ModelObserver
    Observer interface for receiving game state updates and error notifications from the ClientModel.
    MySqlLeaderboardRepository
    MySQL implementation of LeaderboardRepository, backed by a HikariCP connection pool.
    NotificatorCenter
    Central registry that provides access to all notificators.
    OfferCard
    Represents a single Offer Card on the game board.
    OfferCardADelta
    GameDelta sent when a player chooses the "offer" action (card A), gaining food in exchange for returning their totem.
    OfferCardDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to deserialize offer card configurations from the JSON file.
    OfferCardTrack
    Represents the offer track made by offer cards on the game board.
    OfferTrackSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of the offer track.
    OfferTurnCard
    Represents the Offer Turn Card on the game board.
    OfferTurnCardDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to deserialize offer turn mechanics from the JSON file.
    OfferTurnCardSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of the turn-order card.
    OnEndGameNotificator
    Notificator responsible for triggering end-game scoring strategies for every player in the game.
    OnEndOfferPhaseNotificator
    Notificator responsible for triggering a post-offer-phase strategy after the offer (picking) phase ends.
    OnEventNotificator
    Notificator responsible for triggering strategies when an event card is resolved during the end-of-turn phase.
    OnPickNotificator
    Notificator responsible for triggering strategies immediately after a card is picked by the current player.
    OnTotemReturnedNotificator
    Notificator responsible for triggering strategies when the current player's totem is returned from the offer track at the end of a turn.
    OpponentWidgetController
    Controller for the opponent widget displayed on the sides of the game board.
    PhaseSnapshot
    Base type for the serializable snapshot of a game phase.
    PlaceTotemPhase
    Represents the phase where players place their totems on the offer track.
    PlaceTotemPhaseSnapshot
    PhaseSnapshot for the totem-placement phase.
    Player
    Represents a single player in the game, identified by a unique nickname and a totem color.
    PlayerContext
    Holds the set of players taking part in a game together with the one currently acting.
    PlayerContextSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of the player context.
    PlayerOfferPhase
    Represents the main gameplay phase where players acquire cards from the board.
    PlayerOfferPhaseSnapshot
    PhaseSnapshot for the player-offer phase, in which players pick cards in turn.
    PlayerSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of a single player.
    PlayerTribeController
    Controller for the player tribe view, showing all character and building cards owned by a specific player.
    RegistrationAction
    Functional interface describing the trigger binding of a CardStrategy.
    Resource
    Identifies the kind of reward produced by a card effect.
    ResourcePerCharStrategy
    Effect that grants a resource scaled by the number of characters of a given type the current player owns.
    RmiClient
    Client-side RMI endpoint, playing two roles at once: Server proxy (VirtualServer): the client calls RmiClient.joinGame(int, String), RmiClient.placeTotem(String, char), and RmiClient.takeCard(String, String) on this object, which forward to the remote VirtualServerRmi stub looked up in the RMI registry. Remote callback target (VirtualViewRmi): by extending UnicastRemoteObject, this instance is itself exported as a remote object, so the server can invoke RmiClient.showGameDelta(GameDelta), RmiClient.showInitialSnapshot(GameSnapshot), and RmiClient.reportError(String) on it to push updates.
    RmiServer
    Server-side RMI endpoint, exported as the remote object "MesosServer" and looked up by every RmiClient.
    RmiViewAdapter
    Server-side adapter that wraps a single client's VirtualViewRmi remote callback and exposes it through the technology-agnostic VirtualView interface.
    SceneManager
    Singleton-like manager for JavaFX scene transitions.
    ServerMain
    Entry point and lifecycle manager for the Mesos server.
    ShamanEventStrategy
    Shaman event effect, applied to every player when the event resolves.
    ShamanSafetyStrategy
    Building effect that protects the player from shaman-event penalties.
    Showed<T>
    Manages the display and interaction of a dual-row card offering (upper and lower rows).
    SkipDelta
    GameDelta sent when a player skips their action.
    SocketClientHandler
    Server-side handler for a single Socket client connection.
    SocketServerHandler
    Handles client-side communication with the server over a TCP socket.
    SoundCache
    Caches and plays sound effects for the GUI.
    SplashScreenController
    Controller for the splash screen scene.
    StrategyDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to deserialize strategy blueprints from the JSON configuration file.
    SustenanceStrategy
    Sustenance (famine) event effect, applied to every player when the event resolves.
    Totem
    Totem colours assigned to players at the start of the game.
    TotemPlacedDelta
    GameDelta sent when a player places a totem on a track tile.
    Tribe
    Holds the entire mutable state of a single player.
    TribeSnapshot
    Serializable, immutable snapshot of a player's tribe.
    UpdateResourcesStrategy
    Effect that grants the current player a fixed quantity of a given resource.
    VirtualServer
    Technology-agnostic interface representing the server, as seen from the client side.
    VirtualServerRmi
    RMI-specific extension of VirtualServer, exposed by the server as a remote object.
    VirtualServerSocket
    Socket-specific marker interface for VirtualServer.
    VirtualView
    Technology-agnostic interface representing a single client, as seen from the server side.
    VirtualViewRmi
    RMI-specific extension of VirtualView, exposed by each client as a remote object.
    VirtualViewSocket
    Socket-specific marker interface for VirtualView.
    WaitingForPlayersPhase
    The initial state of the game, representing the lobby gathering phase.
    WaitingPhaseSnapshot
    PhaseSnapshot for the phase in which the game is waiting for all players to join.
